query:
CREATE TABLE `wishes` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `studentId` int NOT NULL,
  `topicId` int NOT NULL,
  `priority` int NOT NULL,
  `statement` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` enum('pending','selected','rejected','matched') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `academicYear` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `teacherDecision` enum('pending','approved','rejected') DEFAULT 'pending',
  `decisionAt` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `currentPriority` int DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  INDEX `idx_wishes_studentId` (`studentId`),
  INDEX `idx_wishes_topicId` (`topicId`),
  INDEX `idx_wishes_academicYear` (`academicYear`),
  INDEX `idx_wishes_teacherDecision` (`teacherDecision`),
  INDEX `idx_wishes_composite` (`academicYear`, `teacherDecision`, `topicId`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE `matches` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `studentId` int NOT NULL,
  `topicId` int NOT NULL,
  `teacherId` int NOT NULL,
  `secondTeacherId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `matchRound` int DEFAULT 1,
  `isAdjustment` tinyint DEFAULT 0,
  `academicYear` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `score` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `remarks` text DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  INDEX `idx_matches_studentId` (`studentId`),
  INDEX `idx_matches_topicId` (`topicId`),
  INDEX `idx_matches_teacherId` (`teacherId`),
  INDEX `idx_matches_academicYear` (`academicYear`),
  INDEX `idx_matches_student_year` (`studentId`, `academicYear`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE `conflicts` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `topicId` int NOT NULL,
  `teacherId` int NOT NULL,
  `studentIds` json NOT NULL,
  `selectedStudentId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `matchRound` int DEFAULT 1,
  `deadline` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `resolved` tinyint DEFAULT 0,
  `academicYear` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
